summary: COPEL filed a Form 6-K confirming that BME Markets Exchanges, S.A.U. board approved on October 30, 2026, its request to delist all shares from the Latin American Stock Market (Latibex, ticker XCOPO), effective November 3, 2026; this is the US-equivalent voluntary delisting disclosure following Material Fact 06/2026 of September 17, 2026. No price, premium, or consideration applies; the company's shares continue trading on B3 and the NYSE. Watch residual Latibex liquidity and any index-driven selling, though the dual listing unwind should be largely priced in.
